g.text: Town museum: taking an object off display
Curators can now take an object off display from the admin portal. Its audio guide stops and floor map
pin go at once, so the nightly guide export is retired. Each part of the system is drawn as a box.

g.title: Curator admin (ui): Adds a Take off display button
